title: McHenry Sees Democratic House, GOP Leadership Fight
title_cn: McHenry Sees Democratic House, GOP Leadership Fight
summary: Patrick McHenry, former House Financial Services Committee chair and Bloomberg contributor, says Democrats are likely to win control of the House, though the size of their majority remains uncertain. McHenry says a Republican loss could set up a leadership battle between Jim Jordan and Steve Scalise, with Scalise’s existing leadership infrastructure potentially giving him an advantage. McHenry says Hakeem Jeffries could face a difficult task managing Democrats even if he becomes speaker, particularly with a narrow majority and ideological divisions inside the caucus. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sen. Scott Says US Should ‘Demolish’ Iran’s Regime
title_cn: Sen. Scott Says US Should ‘Demolish’ Iran’s Regime
summary: Sen. Scott (R-FL) says the US should “demolish” Iran’s regime and argues the country must prepare for war to achieve peace and prevent Tehran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. Sen. Scott says the US military has the capability to bring the conflict to a conclusion rather than continue costly operations protecting oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Sen. Scott says he opposes government grants to companies but would prefer taxpayers receive equity when federal money is provided, arguing the government should seek a return on those investments. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
